voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Hungary, eighteen thirty-eight. A nobleman gave his library to the Hungarian Academy of Sciences. In it was a small book that no one can read.
Four hundred and forty-eight pages, written in a script no one has ever identified. Hundreds of different signs.
Among the text, eighty-seven drawings. Christian, Muslim and pagan symbols, side by side.
Its paper was likely made in northern Italy, in the fifteen hundreds. When the writing was added is unknown.
Some scholars call it a forgery. Others have claimed decipherments. None has ever been widely accepted.
